operations.why: The payload holds the structure NBT behind a nullable pointer, so a success boolean precedes it and the NBT is written only when it is true.

evidence.summary: The payload holds the structure as std::unique_ptr<CompoundTag>, so the NBT is absent when the pointer is null.

The serializer inherited by v2225 writes a success boolean and writes network NBT only when success is true; gophertunnel at 8c30047d86617a56e1f1871e3a1d47ec4f670d99 independently uses the same presence framing.
